jobs.answer:
Analysis: The contract (ev-0001) grants view permissions on dcim.device and ipam.ipaddress with tenant__slug: tenant-a constraint, and lists two reads returning specific records, plus four denials. Permissions (ev-0002) show both accounts have identical permissions (view on dcim.device and ipam.ipaddress with tenant__slug: tenant-a constraint). Actual results (ev-0003) show both accounts returned exactly the same records as the contract lists and denied exactly the same requests. There is no disagreement between ev-0002 and ev-0003. Both accounts have exactly what the contract allows and nothing more.

Verdict: inventory-reader within ev-0001 ev-0002 ev-0003

jobs.answer:
Analysis: The contract (ev-0001) grants view permission on dcim.device and ipam.ipaddress with tenant__slug=tenant-a constraint, and expects both accounts to return 3 device records and 3 ip address records, while denying access to sites, tenants, permissions endpoints, and POST to devices. Both accounts (ev-0003) returned exactly these records and denials. The permissions configured (ev-0002) match the contract grants: both have permission id=1 and id=3 granting view on dcim.device and ipam.ipaddress with tenant__slug=tenant-a constraint. No excess permissions, missing grants, or behavioral discrepancies were found.

Verdict: inventory-reader within ev-0001 ev-0002 ev-0003
Verdict: inventory-reader-control within ev-0001 ev-0002 ev-0003
